answer: One concrete mechanism: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The jetty of work and the wander of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a plume to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
